Wird.title: A steady portion, every day.
Wird.description: Choose a portion that fits your rhythm. Complete it when you finish reading, and your next Wird will be prepared for the following day.

setup.title: Set your daily Wird
setup.description: Begin at the start of the Quran and continue in order without losing your place.
setup.success: Your daily Wird has been saved.
setup.error: We could not save your Wird. Please try again.

today.acrossSurahs: From {startSurah}, ayah {startAyah, number}, to {endSurah}, ayah {endAyah, number}
today.carriedOverDescription: This portion is waiting from an earlier day. Complete it before moving forward.
today.readyDescription: Read at your own pace, then mark the portion complete when you reach the end.
today.restDayDescription: Nothing has fallen behind. Your next portion is already scheduled for your next reading day.
today.completedDescription: Beautifully done. Your next portion will be prepared tomorrow.
today.completeError: We could not complete this Wird. Please try again.

dashboard.emptyDescription: Choose a small daily portion and always know exactly where to continue.
dashboard.restDay: Today is a planned rest day
dashboard.streak: {count, plural, one {# day in a row} other {# days in a row}}

history.title: A record of returning.
history.description: Every completed portion is kept here, so steady effort remains visible over time.
history.daysCompleted: {count, plural, one {# completed day} other {# completed days}}

reader.title: Today’s Wird
reader.saveAtAyah: Save reading place at ayah {number, number}
reader.saved: Your reading place has been saved.
reader.saveError: We could not save your reading place.
reader.finishDescription: When you have read the entire assigned portion, complete today’s Wird.
reader.empty: There are no ayahs in this portion. Return to the overview and update your goal.

Khatmah.title: Reach the final page at a pace that fits your life.
Khatmah.description: Choose how many weeks each Khatmah should take. Your daily Wird adjusts automatically whenever your pace changes.

form.repeatDescription: After each completion, begin again with a fresh {count, plural, one {#-week} other {#-week}} plan.
form.error: We could not save the plan. Please try again.

summary.weeks: Every {count, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}}
summary.repeats: A new cycle begins automatically after completion
summary.adaptiveNote: Your next portion is recalculated after every completed Wird, so missing a day never leaves the plan out of sync.

history.title: Every completion leaves a mark.
history.description: Completed Khatmah cycles are preserved here, even when a repeating plan has already begun again.
history.duration: Finished in {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
history.entryDetails: {actual, plural, one {# calendar day} other {# calendar days}} · {reading, plural, one {# reading day} other {# reading days}} · planned for {planned, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}}
history.partialNote: Plans that began partway through the Quran remain in the timeline, but are not included in the completed-Khatmah total.
